limitations: Metadata and document-ID relevance are not clinical correctness.
Gold filters are supplied labels, not predictions by the live query planner.
Search latency excludes embedding, routing and answer generation; P95 uses inclusive linear interpolation.
Three repeated searches provide timing observations, not 60 independent relevance cases.
Frontend 30-question checklist has not been executed.
Metadata enrichment hypotheses were audited but not mixed into this controlled comparison.
Only two fixed-set expected-document cases intersect changed documents after freezing the MFDS guide; this set cannot establish full tokenizer non-inferiority.
Experimental collections share the original dataset_version; isolation is by collection name, not dataset_version alone.
Tokenizer arms ran sequentially; lower observed o200k search times do not establish a causal tokenizer speed improvement.
